snippet.title: Cronos: Lazarus | Reveal Trailer | Story DLC
snippet.description:
Defy the Calling. Bring her back. Wield the Warden's power in LAZARUS, the brutal new DLC chapter to Cronos: The New Dawn story! 
 
Return to the wastelands of New Dawn as the once-loyal Pathfinder in the process of transforming into the Warden you know and love from the base game.  
 
Isolated in the Terminal and severed from the Collective, he devotes every waking moment to awakening a lost Essence he refuses to let fade. 
 
Uncover fragments of Warden’s past, teleport, strike, and outrun a relentless hunter. 
 
Wishlist Cronos: Lazarus (DLC): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4768180/Cronos_Lazarus/

Play Cronos: The New Dawn:

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2101960/Cronos_The_New_Dawn/
Nintendo Shop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cronos-the-new-dawn-switch-2/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011556
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p7tflq7ctxn
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cronos-the-new-dawn-85b409
